The reviewed picker registration path is distinct from projects.createLocal. The qHe createOrSelectLocalProjects implementation requests roots, selects the first returned project and publishes local-project/order/selection updates. createLocal separately parses appearance/name/sources/initGit/setActive, can allocate a default root and returns projectId/rootPaths. Actual injected manager identity, backend success and durable effects remain unobserved.
